description: y_λ values at H_n(R, q_0) evaluated to true 50 dps from the exact symbolic y_λ expressions in y-lambda-wenzl-bridge-symbolic-witness.json. Replaces the f64-truncated witness produced by _deprecated/y_lambda_mpfr_witness.py (line 152: q_str = str(Q0_FLOAT) truncates to 16 digits).
